# SWEEPR VPN & SWEEPR Wi-Fi Radar (sweeprvpn.com)

> SWEEPR VPN is an ultra-lightweight (~14 MB), fast, and easy-to-use VPN and Home Wi-Fi Scanner for Windows 10/11, macOS, and Linux. Built by the team behind SWEEPR Cleaner, it combines 1-click private browsing with a free 30-second Home Wi-Fi & Speed Scanner and a Smart-TV spy blocker.

## Core Capabilities
- **1-Click Private Browsing & Streaming Speed Booster**: Stops internet providers from slowing down evening 4K streaming and gaming. Strict zero-logs policy—we never record, track, or store what websites you visit.
- **Free 30-Second Home Wi-Fi & Speed Scanner**: Scans your home Wi-Fi locally in 30 seconds to show all 15–30+ connected household devices, flag unknown devices, check for router security warnings, and test for internet provider speed slowdowns.
- **SWEEPR Wi-Fi Radar & Smart-TV Shield (Add-On)**:
  - Instant alerts on your screen whenever a stranger or new device joins your home Wi-Fi.
  - 1-click speed booster to stop peak-hour streaming buffering.
  - Automatic Smart-TV spy blocker that stops LG, Samsung, Roku, Vizio, and Fire TV sets from secretly taking screenshots of what you watch.
